item.title: Can You Sell an Inherited House Before Probate Is Finished in Orange County, Florida?
item.dc:creator: Michael Crawford
item.description: Often, yes. Who can sign the deed in an Orange County, Florida probate depends on how the house was titled, the will, and homestead status. Here is how it works.
